correctness.rationale: From the actual closed-support within-color and vertex-coverage cubical model, independent combinatorial enumeration reproduced c0=114,c1=432,c2=378,c3=0. An edge consumes two supports in its color, and with three moving edges no stationary vertex supports remain enough to cover 4 vertices, proving dimension<=2. Frozen CHECK.py and grouped_general.py were read: signed boundaries have 1,512 nonzero d2 entries and square to zero; 305 integral unimodular unit pivots leave a 2-divisible residual, dividing by two gives exactly two unimodular pivots and zero residual, i.e. SNF 1^305,2^2, rank d2=307. Graph of 0/1-cells connected, d1 rank=113; H1 free rank 432-307-113=12, H2=378-307=71, H1 torsion (Z/2)^2. Finite exhaustive integral arithmetic, not mod-two alone.

final_claim: For three distinguishable colors of two mutually indistinguishable robots each, grouped Stirling cubical complex S_(2,2,2)(K4) has H0=Z, H1=Z^12+(Z/2)^2, H2=Z^71, and no higher homology.
